source_manifest.role: current WB55 SPI2 and GPIO BSP binding
canonical operator plus owner wiring prerequisite

facts: FTS02 schematic P5 display FPC pin 14 SDI is on the same direct net named SPI_MOSI as P8 pin 6; no level shifter, output-only buffer, or series-direction element is present on that net.
The display SPI_MISO/SDI return does not use FTS02 P8 pin 5; that separate SPI_MISO net belongs to the SD-card path.
The current WB55 target maps display SDA to PC1. The existing diagnostic deinitializes SPI2 and changes PC1 between push-pull output and no-pull GPIO input for the bounded response.
The canonical operator result and owner chat confirm the actual RES and BUSY wiring requested for this attempt.
SSD1681 four-wire read keeps CS low, sends the command with DC low, then reads data with DC high.
The controller shifts response bits on SCL falling edges; the local reader drives falling edge first and samples after the following rising edge, within the controller data-stability interval.
The read-clock ceiling is 2.5 MHz. HAL GPIO calls plus explicit NOPs are far slower than that ceiling.
Each command ends with PC1 output-low, SCK low, DC high, and CS high.
SSD1681 Deep Sleep is exited only by hardware reset; MCU programming alone does not prove the panel left that state. This is the strongest source-supported explanation for the prior all-FF capture.
The SSD1681 manual initialization flow requires VCI settling, hardware reset, and readiness before commands.
The matching Good Display sample asserts RES low for 10 ms and high for 10 ms, then waits while BUSY is high before initialization commands.
The candidate deliberately uses one conservative 100 ms low plus 100 ms high reset, followed by exactly one bounded 5000 ms BUSY-low wait, and then only the read commands 0x2F and 0x2D.

root_cause_assessment.proven: The prior candidate did not hard-reset the panel and did not wait for BUSY before reading.
root_cause_assessment.inference: A retained Deep Sleep or otherwise not-ready controller can leave the bidirectional SDI net released, yielding the observed repeated all-FF bytes.
root_cause_assessment.unknown: No register read can prove the root cause until the single reset/read attempt returns nontrivial stable bytes.
root_cause_assessment.single_variable: Add exactly one panel hard reset and one bounded ready wait; retain the same PC1 net, command set, read edge, group count, byte counts, and GPIO restore.

revision_caveat: The downloaded FTS02 schematic is the official 2025 revision; this Goal has not independently read the silk revision of the physically connected adapter. The direct-net proof is combined with the owner-confirmed exact RES/BUSY wiring and existing successful display write transport. This admits one bounded diagnostic attempt, not production promotion.
non_claims: No waveform tuning, visual cutoff repair, residue acceptance, temperature rule, or production behavior.
No authorization for 0x27, 0x37, 0x41, RAM/LUT/OTP writes, refresh, White/Black, rail, FPC, V9, Rig, CRIG, browser, binding, touch, or BLE work.
No claim that a fast or residue-free result exists before the one bounded machine capture.
